preconditions.description: The number of BubbleCores N is between 3 and 15,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and 0 <= int(u) != int(v) < int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the N lines contains two distinct integers U and V representing valid BubbleCore indices (0 ≤ U ≠ V < N).
The input contains exactly N+1 lines (1 for N, N for edges).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum possible sum of all BubbleCores' potentials, where N is the number of BubbleCores and edges are the connections between them.
